title.zh: Chinese fraud victims lose key court battle over 61,000 Bitcoin
title.en: Chinese fraud victims lose key court battle over 61,000 Bitcoin

current_state.zh: London's High Court ruled that Chinese law, not English law, must govern claims by Chinese fraud victims seeking to recover 61,000 Bitcoin seized by the UK government, leaving the merits of their ownership claims to later proceedings.
current_state.en: London's High Court ruled that Chinese law, not English law, must govern claims by Chinese fraud victims seeking to recover 61,000 Bitcoin seized by the UK government, leaving the merits of their ownership claims to later proceedings.
